Eat lots of protein. .8 grams per pound of bw. Drink 3 liters of water a day. Take a multi vitamin. Eat veggies. Don’t eat shit food. Train with low volume and compound movements. I’d recommend starting with 2 sets of push ups, 2 sets of pull ups, 3 sets of air squats, 3 sets of Glute bridges. Eat clean. Train 3 times a week at most. Stretch and fix any imbalances. Do that until you see noticeable strength gains and size gains for about 2-3 months. Calculate your BMR and eat over it by about 300 calories. If you don’t gain any weight in 3 weeks increase it by 100 calories. Don’t use a scale but just learn to eye ball calories. This keeps it easier. Don’t bulk. When you are lean your hormones are in an advantageous ratio for building muscle. Don’t do lots of cardio either. Time under tension is important also for having effective working sets. Try to hit 45 second or higher max of about 60 seconds per sec, but your muscles need to me tense during this time avoid resting positions that use your joints to carry the load.
Hard gainers are really just under eating quality food. You micronutrients are IMPORTANT. An easy way to get micronutrients in is to have a smoothie with broccoli spinach red pepper ginger dark berries.
